prompt:

Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-30):
| Return 3m            | +16.7% |
| Return 1m            | +17.9% |
| Return 1w            | +3.3% |
| Range position (63d) | 100% |
| 21d realized vol     | 27% |
| Last close           | 91.50 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has enjoyed strong near-term momentum, with 3-month and 1-month returns around +16–18% and a positive weekly move. However, its 63-day range position is at 100%, suggesting it may be near a resistance level and could face a pullback or consolidation over the next 20 trading days. Given the directional bias yet elevated positioning, a cautious stance is warranted.

DECISION: HOLD
